00:32:46,362 --> 00:32:48,863
I'll tell you i'm going to rub.

681
00:32:48,863 --> 00:32:51,366
Oh!

682
00:33:18,391 --> 00:33:19,892
When i was in school,

683
00:33:19,892 --> 00:33:23,396
I had a parttime job walking people's dogs.

684
00:33:23,396 --> 00:33:25,398
Who knew you could make money wagging your tail?

685
00:33:37,309 --> 00:33:39,276
Some turnout, huh?

686
00:33:39,777 --> 00:33:41,729
Congratulations, baby. Thank you,

687
00:33:42,229 --> 00:33:45,232
But i owe it all to michael for delivering divina.

688
00:33:45,733 --> 00:33:46,734
There you go. Thanks.

689
00:33:47,234 --> 00:33:48,235
Oh, show's about to start.

690
00:33:48,736 --> 00:33:51,237
Ooh.

691
00:33:51,237 --> 00:33:53,222
See ya.

692
00:33:53,723 --> 00:33:56,726
Aren't you going to stay?

693
00:33:56,726 --> 00:33:57,727
Hey, are you sticking around?

694
00:33:57,727 --> 00:33:59,228
I thought you were his number one fan.

695
00:33:59,712 --> 00:34:01,214
Just leave me alone.

696
00:34:01,214 --> 00:34:04,166
How can somebody put on an act like that all these years?

697
00:34:04,166 --> 00:34:05,634
I'd rather have a high colonic

698
00:34:05,634 --> 00:34:07,135
Than hear some old queen do "rose's turn".

699
00:34:07,135 --> 00:34:11,573
I mean my mother.

700
00:34:11,573 --> 00:34:12,574
You don't know for sure.

701
00:34:12,574 --> 00:34:14,509
That my mom lied to me?

702
00:34:14,509 --> 00:34:17,011
That my father's not a war hero, he's...

703
00:34:17,011 --> 00:34:19,964
judy garland?

704
00:34:19,964 --> 00:34:26,470
Would you prefer bette davis?

705
00:34:26,971 --> 00:34:28,471
Maybe i should just forget it.

706
00:34:28,471 --> 00:34:29,973
And now, ladies and gentlemen,

707
00:34:30,473 --> 00:34:32,942
Ladies who are gentlemen, gentlemen who are ladies

708
00:34:32,942 --> 00:34:35,895
And anyone else that management sincerely regrets having omitted,

709
00:34:35,895 --> 00:34:38,331
The angel ball welcomes its favourite angel,

710
00:34:38,331 --> 00:34:41,767
Pittsburgh's own miss divina devore.

711
00:34:54,712 --> 00:34:57,215
Look up there!

712
00:35:28,894 --> 00:35:30,879
Ooh, pittsburgh.

713
00:35:49,146 --> 00:35:51,148
Michael.

714
00:35:51,148 --> 00:35:52,649
May i come in? Well, i...

715
00:35:53,150 --> 00:35:55,151
usually don't undress in front of men i barely know,

716
00:35:55,151 --> 00:35:58,654
But, i your case, i'll make an exception.

717
00:35:58,654 --> 00:36:01,657
How'd it go? Did "angels over pittsburgh"

718
00:36:01,657 --> 00:36:04,160
Make buckets of bucks?

719
00:36:04,160 --> 00:36:05,661
Enough to bail them out for a while.

720
00:36:05,661 --> 00:36:06,661
It was great of you to help.

721
00:36:06,661 --> 00:36:08,663
Well, it's the last benefit i'll ever do.

722
00:36:08,663 --> 00:36:09,664
Somehow i doubt that.

723
00:36:10,148 --> 00:36:13,118
Well...

724
00:36:13,118 --> 00:36:15,120
you take care of yourself, michael.

725
00:36:15,120 --> 00:36:16,621
It was nice to meet you.

726
00:36:17,122 --> 00:36:18,123
Actually, i have another favour.

727
00:36:18,623 --> 00:36:21,058
Oh, for... heaven's sake,

728
00:36:21,058 --> 00:36:23,561
Haven't we done enough for humanity?

729
00:36:23,561 --> 00:36:27,565
Any more and... and i'll be irritable all week.

730
00:36:27,565 --> 00:36:29,066
It's not charity.

731
00:36:29,066 --> 00:36:32,035
Although you'd be helping me out a lot if you'd look at this.

732
00:36:32,535 --> 00:36:34,971
It's your old high school yearbook.

733
00:36:34,971 --> 00:36:40,960
And this is you.

734
00:36:40,960 --> 00:36:42,962
Oh, my god.

735
00:36:42,962 --> 00:36:45,464
I haven't seen that in 30...

736
00:36:45,464 --> 00:36:47,466
make that 18 years.

737
00:36:47,466 --> 00:36:49,401
Notice any resemblance?

738
00:36:49,885 --> 00:36:52,337
Yeah. It's unmistakable.

739
00:36:52,337 --> 00:36:55,824
I look exactly like tom cruise.

740
00:36:55,824 --> 00:36:58,242
I meant to me.

741
00:36:58,242 --> 00:37:01,746
You.

742
00:37:01,746 --> 00:37:03,748
Well, i appreciate the flattery,

743
00:37:03,748 --> 00:37:06,250
But frankly, no. I don't see it.

744
00:37:06,751 --> 00:37:08,252
How can you miss it?

745
00:37:08,252 --> 00:37:09,753
I mean, the way you looked back then, the way i look now.

746
00:37:09,753 --> 00:37:12,255
I mean, we're practically identical twins.

747
00:37:12,255 --> 00:37:14,191
Well, i suppose if you squint

748
00:37:14,691 --> 00:37:17,194
There's a slight resemblance. But so what?

749
00:37:17,194 --> 00:37:20,197
Here, help me with this zipper.

750
00:37:20,197 --> 00:37:21,697
I asked for a dresser,

751
00:37:22,198 --> 00:37:27,102
And they're too goddamn cheap... are you my father?

752
00:37:27,102 --> 00:37:29,555
This is a fine time to ask.

753
00:37:30,055 --> 00:37:32,057
As you're helping me out of my gown.

754
00:37:32,057 --> 00:37:33,558
You were seeing my mother then.

755
00:37:33,558 --> 00:37:35,560
The timing is exactly right for you to have...

756
00:37:35,560 --> 00:37:36,995
knocked her up?

757
00:37:37,495 --> 00:37:40,498
First, i would've had to have gotten it up.

758
00:37:40,498 --> 00:37:43,001
What, you mean, you and she never...

759
00:37:43,001 --> 00:37:45,003
look at me.

760
00:37:45,003 --> 00:37:46,503
Do i look like the kind of guy

761
00:37:46,503 --> 00:37:50,424
Who goes around banging babes?

762
00:37:50,424 --> 00:37:52,860
Your mother was hardly my type.

763
00:37:52,860 --> 00:37:54,862
But you said she was beautiful

764
00:37:54,862 --> 00:37:56,864
And that back then you used to bat for the other team.

765
00:37:57,364 --> 00:37:58,865
Drag queens are notorious liars,

766
00:37:58,865 --> 00:38:01,801
Everyone knows that.

767
00:38:01,801 --> 00:38:04,303
So, what does your mother say?

768
00:38:04,303 --> 00:38:05,304
She says my father

769
00:38:05,304 --> 00:38:07,290
Is this big war hero.

770
00:38:07,290 --> 00:38:10,725
So, why don't you believe that?

771
00:38:10,725 --> 00:38:12,727
Because the story keeps changing, and the...

772
00:38:12,727 --> 00:38:16,231
there's only one picture, and the guy doesn't even look like me.

773
00:38:16,731 --> 00:38:18,733
Look, i'm not making any demands.

774
00:38:18,733 --> 00:38:20,735
I'm not even asking that we stay in touch,

775
00:38:20,735 --> 00:38:26,740
I just want to know the truth.

776
00:38:26,740 --> 00:38:29,243
Michael, may i...

777
00:38:29,243 --> 00:38:35,682
tell you the one truth i've learned in all my years?

778
00:38:35,682 --> 00:38:38,184
The truth...

779
00:38:38,184 --> 00:38:43,606
is what you choose to believe.

780
00:38:43,606 --> 00:38:44,607
When i'm on stage,

781
00:38:44,607 --> 00:38:49,561
People believe i'm divina devore.

782
00:38:49,561 --> 00:38:52,564
Not because i'm a great female impersonator,

783
00:38:52,564 --> 00:38:55,484
But because they want to.

784
00:38:55,484 --> 00:38:57,486
What does it have to do with whether you're my father,

785
00:38:57,486 --> 00:39:00,988
O-Or if my mother lied to me?

786
00:39:01,489 --> 00:39:02,990
Your mother...

787
00:39:02,990 --> 00:39:05,993
gave you something to believe in.

788
00:39:05,993 --> 00:39:07,495
A hero.

789
00:39:07,495 --> 00:39:09,997
A father you could be proud of.

790
00:39:10,498 --> 00:39:14,000
Because she loves you.

791
00:39:14,000 --> 00:39:17,003
That's the truth.

792
00:39:17,003 --> 00:39:21,508
Whether you choose to believe it or not...

793
00:39:21,508 --> 00:39:29,014
is up to you.

794
00:39:49,416 --> 00:39:50,417
Still here?

795
00:39:50,417 --> 00:39:53,320
So, how did i do?

796
00:39:53,320 --> 00:39:54,821
Not bad...

797
00:39:54,821 --> 00:39:59,743
for your first time.

798
00:39:59,743 --> 00:40:03,195
But, the tips suck.

799
00:40:03,195 --> 00:40:04,697
What were you expecting?

800
00:40:05,197 --> 00:40:08,200
More than i make working at the diner.

801
00:40:08,200 --> 00:40:11,137
Well, you need to dance on the bar.

802
00:40:11,137 --> 00:40:12,138
How do i do that?

803
00:40:12,605 --> 00:40:14,572
Look, you gotta work your way up.

804
00:40:14,572 --> 00:40:15,573
Maybe in six months.

805
00:40:16,074 --> 00:40:19,010
Huh, six months?

806
00:40:19,010 --> 00:40:21,963
I need money now to pay for school.

807
00:40:22,464 --> 00:40:30,921
That is a problem.

808
00:40:30,921 --> 00:40:34,341
Tell you what.

809
00:40:34,341 --> 00:40:43,650
You give me some time, i'll give you some time.

810
00:40:43,650 --> 00:40:46,602
No, thanks.

811
00:40:46,602 --> 00:40:49,105
Up to you. Oh, but if you change your mind

812
00:40:49,105 --> 00:40:51,106
And decide you want to make, say...

813
00:40:51,106 --> 00:41:40,685
a couple of thou' a month, let me know.

814
00:42:12,031 --> 00:42:15,000
Still up?

815
00:42:15,501 --> 00:42:20,505
Yeah, i'm doing my homework.

816
00:42:21,005 --> 00:42:22,507
It's late.

817
00:42:22,507 --> 00:42:25,009
I had to talk to the boss.

818
00:42:25,009 --> 00:42:27,512
Mm-Hmm.

819
00:42:28,012 --> 00:42:31,932
He said starting tomorrow i could dance on the bar.

820
00:42:31,932 --> 00:42:34,435
After only one night?

821
00:42:34,435 --> 00:42:53,820
I told you i can take care of myself.

822
00:42:53,820 --> 00:43:07,231
Yeah, i guess you can.

823
00:43:15,239 --> 00:43:18,192
Ma, what are you doing up so late?

824
00:43:18,692 --> 00:43:21,194
Um... couldn't sleep.

825
00:43:21,194 --> 00:43:23,146
What about you?

826
00:43:23,146 --> 00:43:26,082
Same.

827
00:43:26,082 --> 00:43:29,068
I came to return this.

828
00:43:29,569 --> 00:43:32,004
You can have it.

829
00:43:32,004 --> 00:43:34,006
What are you doing?

830
00:43:34,490 --> 00:43:35,457
Just putting things away,

831
00:43:35,958 --> 00:43:37,459
Making room.

832
00:43:37,960 --> 00:43:39,962
Something i should've done a long time ago.

833
00:43:39,962 --> 00:43:42,381
It's dad's shrine.

834
00:43:42,381 --> 00:43:43,832
Yeah, so?

835
00:43:43,832 --> 00:43:46,767
So, you can't just get rid of it.

836
00:43:46,767 --> 00:43:50,271
No need for it now.

837
00:43:50,271 --> 00:43:53,758
What are you talking about?

838
00:43:53,758 --> 00:43:59,146
There's no need to pretend, michael.

839
00:43:59,146 --> 00:44:04,050
The truth is... just like you said.

840
00:44:04,050 --> 00:44:06,520
My father...

841
00:44:06,520 --> 00:44:10,489
is lieutenant john michael novotny.

842
00:44:10,489 --> 00:44:17,446
Died in vietnam, april 10th, 1970.

843
00:44:17,446 --> 00:44:19,949
He was killed just two weeks after i was born,

844
00:44:19,949 --> 00:44:22,450
When the jeep he was driving ran over a land mine

845
00:44:22,917 --> 00:44:24,419
While he was carving a path through the jungle

846
00:44:24,919 --> 00:44:30,859
On a mission to save his troops.

847
00:44:30,859 --> 00:44:34,294
Right, ma?

848
00:44:34,294 --> 00:44:37,231
Right.

849
00:44:37,231 --> 00:44:41,235
For which he was posthumously awarded...

850
00:44:41,735 --> 00:44:50,660
the purple heart.

851
00:44:50,660 --> 00:44:54,614
And his last words were...

852
00:44:55,114 --> 00:44:57,617
"tell my son

853
00:44:57,617 --> 00:45:00,118
I love him more...

854
00:45:00,619 --> 00:45:04,072
than life itself...

855
00:45:04,573 --> 00:45:13,547
and i'll always be proud of him."



## S03E01

1
00:00:00,000 --> 00:00:04,162
WWW.MY-SUBS.CO

1
00:00:22,242 --> 00:00:24,175

2

The crowd is going wild.

3
00:00:25,776 --> 00:00:28,309
Mighty mike novotny has taken it on the chin

4
00:00:28,309 --> 00:00:30,541
From mad dog kinney.

5
00:00:30,541 --> 00:00:33,741
Seven, eight, nine. Get up, you bum.

6
00:00:33,741 --> 00:00:36,841
The winner and new champion is...

7
00:00:36,841 --> 00:00:39,207
Hold it. Before we crown the champ,

8

Let's give all you sports fans a blowby-Blow recap,

9
00:00:41,674 --> 00:00:44,440
So can see for yourselves what the fuck just happened.

Tell you the truth, i wouldn'tmind knowing

11

What the fuck happened myself.

12

It was a week ago, the night that mad dog...

i mean, brian; threw the party for "rage".

00:01:01,571 --> 00:01:03,003
Whoo!

15
00:01:04,070 --> 00:01:05,904
Let's go back to my place.

16
00:01:22,269 --> 00:01:24,770
Well, i would say that "rage" is all the rage.

17
00:01:24,770 --> 00:01:25,769
Yeah.

18
00:01:29,335 --> 00:01:30,836
Aw-W-W...

19
00:01:30,836 --> 00:01:31,769
see you later.

20
00:01:32,835 --> 00:01:35,301
Yeah, much, much later.

21
00:01:35,301 --> 00:01:36,601
God. Do you think

22
00:01:36,601 --> 00:01:39,134
They're actually going to... do it?

23
00:01:39,134 --> 00:01:40,134
Hey, what do you say

24
00:01:40,134 --> 00:01:41,134
That we go home

25
00:01:41,134 --> 00:01:42,501
And continue the celebration, huh?

26
00:01:42,501 --> 00:01:44,868
In a minute. I have to find brian. Okay.

27
00:01:44,868 --> 00:01:46,668
Last time i saw him,

28
00:01:46,668 --> 00:01:48,033
He was feeling no pain.

29
00:01:48,033 --> 00:01:49,166
Yeah, getting it on

30
00:01:49,166 --> 00:01:52,799
With shirtless wonder 4,689.

31
00:01:52,799 --> 00:01:54,899
He and justin just broke up.

32
00:01:55,965 --> 00:01:57,165
What?

33
00:01:57,165 --> 00:01:58,599
What are you talking about?

34
00:01:58,599 --> 00:02:00,566
Justin's been seeing someone else.

35
00:02:00,566 --> 00:02:03,565
Oh, aren't they always seeing somebody else?

36
00:02:03,565 --> 00:02:05,064
This time, it's different.

37
00:02:08,997 --> 00:02:10,131
I'll be back.

38
00:02:16,464 --> 00:02:18,230
Taxi!

39
00:02:21,995 --> 00:02:23,162
Ah-H. It just bugs me,

40
00:02:23,162 --> 00:02:24,429
'Cause he doesn't even seem to...

41
00:02:24,429 --> 00:02:25,429
brian!

42
00:02:25,429 --> 00:02:27,329
Brian!

43
00:02:41,060 --> 00:02:42,227
Hmmmm.

44
00:02:55,259 --> 00:02:56,860
I promised i'd serenade you awake, didn't i?

45
00:03:04,426 --> 00:03:06,558
You also promised me breakfast in bed.

46
00:03:06,558 --> 00:03:07,558
Ah-Ha.

47
00:03:11,257 --> 00:03:12,324
Dark chocolate.

48
00:03:12,324 --> 00:03:14,024
Is there any other kind?

49
00:03:15,090 --> 00:03:16,491
Hmm.

50
00:03:16,491 --> 00:03:18,658
I can't believe you're finally here,

51
00:03:18,658 --> 00:03:21,089
That we actually spent the entire night together.

52
00:03:24,623 --> 00:03:25,557
I'm here...

53
00:03:26,924 --> 00:03:28,023
but i can't stay.

54
00:03:29,089 --> 00:03:31,155
Oh-H... i have to go to class,

55
00:03:31,155 --> 00:03:32,088
Ah. Then to work.

56
00:03:33,856 --> 00:03:35,422
Oh, i also have to pick up my stuff.

57
00:03:39,021 --> 00:03:39,954
What if he's there?

58
00:03:41,188 --> 00:03:43,154
What if he is?

59
00:03:43,154 --> 00:03:44,221
I don't care.

60
00:03:45,688 --> 00:03:46,922
I'm with you now.

61
00:04:18,485 --> 00:04:20,884
Brian...

62
00:04:20,884 --> 00:04:22,617
where the fuck are you? Are you all right?

63
00:04:22,617 --> 00:04:23,850
Call me.

64
00:04:23,850 --> 00:04:26,416
That'll be 5.25, with tax.

65
00:04:26,416 --> 00:04:28,283
I'll take a rage t-Shirt too.

66
00:04:28,283 --> 00:04:30,216
Oh, this is not for sale.

67
00:04:30,216 --> 00:04:31,883
Do you have any more copies?

68
00:04:31,883 --> 00:04:33,650
Looks like i just sold my last one.

69
00:04:33,650 --> 00:04:35,216
When is issue two coming out?

70
00:04:35,216 --> 00:04:36,316
It's not.

71
00:04:36,316 --> 00:04:38,016
But what's going to happen to rage and j.T.?

72
00:04:38,016 --> 00:04:39,649
Are they going to get together? Yeah,

73
00:04:39,649 --> 00:04:42,182
And will zephyr have a cosmic meltdown if they do?

74
00:04:42,182 --> 00:04:43,948
I guess we'll never know, so...

75
00:04:43,948 --> 00:04:46,314
hang on to your comic books, guys.

76
00:04:46,314 --> 00:04:48,581
It's about to become a true collector's item.

77
00:05:00,814 --> 00:05:01,747
Brian?

78
00:05:07,613 --> 00:05:08,547
Brian...

79
00:05:34,777 --> 00:05:35,709
ahh.

80
00:07:19,365 --> 00:07:21,198
Okay, time to put that away

81
00:07:21,198 --> 00:07:22,498
And eat your pink-Plate specials

82
00:07:22,498 --> 00:07:24,165
Before they get cold. There you go, baby.

83
00:07:24,165 --> 00:07:25,465
Thank you. Thanks.

84
00:07:25,465 --> 00:07:26,565
You know you wrote that, don't you?

85
00:07:26,565 --> 00:07:27,565
My son,

86
00:07:27,565 --> 00:07:28,865
Michael novotny.

87
00:07:28,865 --> 00:07:31,197
Hey, no snatching the lemon bars,

88
00:07:31,197 --> 00:07:32,731
Even if you are a genius.

89
00:07:35,063 --> 00:07:36,431
You did it, didn't you?

90
00:07:36,431 --> 00:07:38,130
We know you did it.

91
00:07:38,130 --> 00:07:40,164
Was it heaven? Was it bliss?

92
00:07:40,164 --> 00:07:42,163
Permit me to do the crossexamining.

93
00:07:42,163 --> 00:07:43,630
Who was top? Who was bottom? Hmm?

94
00:07:43,630 --> 00:07:45,196
Christ, you sound like me.

95
00:07:45,196 --> 00:07:46,529
Hold on. Did i miss something?

102

108

111

114

Ben...

121

127

Larry, the court just sent us a...

Mel...

Ben, I finished your book,

00:13:44,617 --> 00:13:46,850
Ben, I finished your book,

Play with this long enough, and you will be.

It's just been a long time since I've lived alone.

362

366

34

36

Our son.

40

41

"To experience the greatest joy I've ever known

Ma!

lost.

Really?

264
00:16:23,187 --> 00:16:26,439
Okay. Chopped beef and tuna surprise.

265
00:16:26,474 --> 00:16:28,821
Personally, I don't care for surprises.

266
00:16:28,856 --> 00:16:32,545
Ted and Emmett better get back from their sightseeing excursion or they're going to miss it.

267
00:16:35,505 --> 00:16:37,730
Excuse me.

268
00:16:38,575 --> 00:16:40,708
Pardon me, mister.

269
00:16:41,377 --> 00:16:43,241
You talking to me?

270
00:16:43,276 --> 00:16:46,287
You're in severe pain.

271
00:16:46,322 --> 00:16:49,609
You should be resting. What the hell are you doing?

272
00:16:49,644 --> 00:16:51,789
Practicing riding one-handed.

273
00:16:51,824 --> 00:16:53,434
You're not seriously...

274
00:16:53,469 --> 00:16:54,830
Yes, I am seriously.

275
00:16:54,865 --> 00:16:56,274
But you're seriously injured.

276
00:16:56,309 --> 00:16:58,775
Could we stop using the word seriously?

277
00:16:58,810 --> 00:17:00,219
They're sending someone to take you back.

278
00:17:00,254 --> 00:17:00,992
I'm not going.

279
00:17:01,027 --> 00:17:02,898
Yes you are. The paramedic told you...

280
00:17:02,933 --> 00:17:04,455
Fuck what the paramedic told me.

281
00:17:04,490 --> 00:17:06,215
There's no way you can bicycle all the way back to...

282
00:17:06,250 --> 00:17:10,467
And stop telling me what I fucking can't do.

283
00:17:22,180 --> 00:17:24,820
See you on the road.

284
00:17:33,274 --> 00:17:35,474
Hey Brett. Go ahead.

285
00:17:45,023 --> 00:17:47,023
Hey, Brett. Nice to see you.

286
00:17:47,058 --> 00:17:49,284
This place seems pretty exclusive.

287
00:17:49,319 --> 00:17:51,029
Nah, they're just people.

288
00:17:51,064 --> 00:17:52,443
Rich people.

289
00:17:52,478 --> 00:17:54,035
Gorgeous people.

290
00:17:54,070 --> 00:17:55,507
Famous people.

291
00:17:56,004 --> 00:17:58,140
Something tells me you'll feel at home here in no time.

292
00:17:58,175 --> 00:18:00,473
It's going to be tough going back to Pittsburgh after this.

293
00:18:00,508 --> 00:18:01,269
Hey, Brett.

294
00:18:01,304 --> 00:18:02,640
Then why go?

295
00:18:02,675 --> 00:18:05,075
Stay here. Work in the movies.

296
00:18:05,102 --> 00:18:07,971
Isn't that everyone's dream? It was mine.

297
00:18:08,006 --> 00:18:09,612
And do what?

298
00:18:09,647 --> 00:18:12,551
Assistant art director on "Rage".

299
00:18:12,586 --> 00:18:14,158
Are you kidding?

300
00:18:14,193 --> 00:18:20,217
You've got talent, passion, ambition, and if I may add, the backing of an A-list director.

301
00:18:20,252 --> 00:18:22,131
What else do you need?

302
00:18:22,166 --> 00:18:24,655
How long would I be here for?

303
00:18:24,690 --> 00:18:27,257
Six, eight months, depending on the schedule.

304
00:18:27,292 --> 00:18:29,641
- Brettski! - Hey, Con.

305
00:18:32,193 --> 00:18:33,785
You, uh, remember Justin?

306
00:18:33,820 --> 00:18:36,066
Of course. The man who makes Rage fly.

307
00:18:36,166 --> 00:18:38,132
It's nice to see you again.

308
00:18:38,267 --> 00:18:40,297
Fenderman gave us the green light.

309
00:18:40,332 --> 00:18:41,906
Awesome. Congrats.

310
00:18:41,941 --> 00:18:44,488
A script's coming your way, so keep going to the gym.

311
00:18:44,523 --> 00:18:46,183
Those tights show no mercy.

312
00:18:46,218 --> 00:18:48,315
Come on, I'll buy you guys a drink to celebrate.

313
00:18:48,350 --> 00:18:49,730
Then maybe we can go back to my place.

314
00:18:49,765 --> 00:18:54,773
I'd love to, but there are some faces I want to flaunt the news in. But why don't you two go?

315
00:19:10,577 --> 00:19:13,547
I think we should have taken a left at this little squiggle here.

316
00:19:13,577 --> 00:19:17,076
I thought you knew how to read a map.

317
00:19:17,111 --> 00:19:18,836
Of course I know how to read a map.

318
00:19:18,871 --> 00:19:21,910
You go down this road, make a left at "up yours",

319
00:19:21,945 --> 00:19:24,356
then continue on about three miles to "go fuck yourself".

320
00:19:28,995 --> 00:19:31,428
Teddy, what is it?

321
00:19:32,204 --> 00:19:35,577
It's dark, we're lost,

322
00:19:35,612 --> 00:19:37,635
I'm never making it to that meeting,

323
00:19:37,665 --> 00:19:40,426
I'm having a panic attack...

324
00:19:40,461 --> 00:19:43,866
and why did I listen to you in the first place?

325
00:19:44,615 --> 00:19:46,882
Just trying to help.

326
00:19:46,917 --> 00:19:48,927
Well, you're only making things worse.

327
00:19:57,337 --> 00:19:59,026
You know what?

328
00:19:59,061 --> 00:20:01,110
We're going to have a meeting,

329
00:20:01,145 --> 00:20:04,146
right here, right now.

330
00:20:04,181 --> 00:20:05,508
With what? Livestock?

331
00:20:05,543 --> 00:20:09,589
It only takes two people to have a meeting, right?

332
00:20:09,624 --> 00:20:11,279
One to talk, one to listen.

333
00:20:11,923 --> 00:20:15,188
Uh, this meeting will now come to order.

334
00:20:16,979 --> 00:20:18,315
Now what?

335
00:20:18,792 --> 00:20:22,085
Well, since it's my birthday, someone needs to introduce me.

336
00:20:22,120 --> 00:20:25,555
Well, guess that would be me.

337
00:20:25,590 --> 00:20:28,133
Uh... Attention, everyone.

338
00:20:28,672 --> 00:20:30,659
We have a birthday tonight.

339
00:20:30,694 --> 00:20:33,365
That's right. Six months, clean and sober.

340
00:20:33,400 --> 00:20:35,257
You know him. You love him.

341
00:20:35,292 --> 00:20:39,800
The one, the only, Ted Schmidt.

342
00:20:41,406 --> 00:20:43,371
How was that?

343
00:20:43,406 --> 00:20:46,192
Perfect, if I was appearing at the Copacabana.

344
00:20:47,493 --> 00:20:49,680
And we only use first names. It's anonymous.

345
00:20:49,880 --> 00:20:52,610
Oh, sorry, Ted.

346
00:20:52,645 --> 00:20:55,975
Go on. Get up there.

347
00:20:59,055 --> 00:21:00,732
This is ridiculous.

348
00:21:11,352 --> 00:21:13,538
Hi. I'm Ted

349
00:21:13,573 --> 00:21:16,254
I'm a substance abuser.

350
00:21:19,189 --> 00:21:21,157
You're supposed to say, "Hi, Ted".

351
00:21:21,376 --> 00:21:23,458
Oh, right. Hi, Ted.

352
00:21:24,735 --> 00:21:26,086
Now what?

353
00:21:26,121 --> 00:21:29,984
Well, now I tell everyone, or in this case, one,

354
00:21:30,019 --> 00:21:34,496
that it's my birthday, and then they bring me a cake.

355
00:21:34,531 --> 00:21:38,176
Cake. Cake. Oh...

356
00:21:42,045 --> 00:21:45,581
How's this?

357
00:21:48,370 --> 00:21:49,617
What next?

358
00:21:49,896 --> 00:21:50,906
Then I share.

359
00:21:55,124 --> 00:21:59,753
Six months ago, my life was out of control. I was lost.

360
00:21:59,788 --> 00:22:06,732
But now, thanks to Bill W., the good lord, and the program...

361
00:22:08,470 --> 00:22:11,671
my life has turned around.

362
00:22:15,124 --> 00:22:17,398
I now have faith.

363
00:22:17,433 --> 00:22:20,308
I have purpose.

364
00:22:22,139 --> 00:22:23,736
But most of all...

365
00:22:25,548 --> 00:22:28,522
I have wonderful friends...

366
00:22:30,073 --> 00:22:32,768
who've stood by me...

367
00:22:34,281 --> 00:22:36,844
and helped lead me down the right road.

368
00:22:36,879 --> 00:22:39,995
Thank god they didn't need a map to do it.

369
00:22:43,567 --> 00:22:46,484
Uh. Thank you for listening.

370
00:22:46,519 --> 00:22:48,917
Thank you, ladies.

371
00:22:49,152 --> 00:22:51,827
And then we cut the cake.

372
00:23:00,287 --> 00:23:02,222
Happy birthday, teddy.

373
00:23:02,257 --> 00:23:04,368
Thanks, Em.

374
00:23:16,552 --> 00:23:18,527
What do we do now?

375
00:23:20,001 --> 00:23:22,879
Now is when we usually go out for coffee.

376
00:25:33,207 --> 00:25:35,556
That's it. I'm... I'm calling for help.

377
00:25:35,656 --> 00:25:37,110
The fuck you are.

378
00:25:38,373 --> 00:25:40,623
Would you just go on and ride with your husband?

379
00:25:40,658 --> 00:25:42,368
And leave you alone?

380
00:25:43,293 --> 00:25:44,646
I'll be all right.

381
00:25:44,681 --> 00:25:46,355
Yeah, I can see that.

382
00:25:46,390 --> 00:25:48,744
I'm staying here with you.

383
00:25:51,858 --> 00:25:54,261
Why are you doing this?

384
00:25:54,296 --> 00:25:56,192
To show everyone what a hero you are?

385
00:25:56,227 --> 00:25:58,651
That despite insurmountable odds, the...

386
00:25:58,686 --> 00:26:03,082
...great Kinney can cross the finish line with one arm tied behind his back?

387
00:26:04,138 --> 00:26:05,835
In front of my back.

388
00:26:05,870 --> 00:26:07,611
In front of your back.

389
00:26:08,479 --> 00:26:11,271
There's no need to, you've already proved yourself.

390
00:26:11,306 --> 00:26:15,214
You've raised $100,000 for the hospice. What more do you need to do?

391
00:26:15,594 --> 00:26:18,276
It's not about the money.

392
00:26:18,455 --> 00:26:20,113
Then what's it about? Killing yourself?

393
00:26:20,148 --> 00:26:21,565
Would you fuck off?

394
00:26:22,344 --> 00:26:24,752
I can do it.

395
00:26:28,844 --> 00:26:33,785
Did you ever see that story on TV about those women...

396
00:26:33,820 --> 00:26:36,394
that had cancer?

397
00:26:40,196 --> 00:26:43,868
Anyway, they all had cancer.

398
00:26:45,346 --> 00:26:47,703
So what do they do?

399
00:26:47,738 --> 00:26:50,629
They go to this boot camp...

400
00:26:50,664 --> 00:26:54,220
where they have to climb over walls and crawl through the mud,

401
00:26:54,255 --> 00:26:57,415
and swing over these bottomless pits while this

402
00:26:57,450 --> 00:27:01,652
former Luftwaffe drill sergeant terrorizes them.

403
00:27:01,687 --> 00:27:04,349
And I'm watching this and I'm thinking,

404
00:27:04,384 --> 00:27:08,450
"Christ! Don't these crazy bitches have enough shit to deal with?"

405
00:27:11,364 --> 00:27:16,658
Then one of them comes out of this swamp that's full of fucking crocodiles or sharks or something.

406
00:27:18,224 --> 00:27:21,152
And she's laughing.

407
00:27:23,205 --> 00:27:25,229
Laughing.

408
00:27:29,627 --> 00:27:32,089
And she says...

409
00:27:33,679 --> 00:27:38,402
"if I can survive this, I can survive anything."

410
00:27:49,658 --> 00:27:51,819
Come on.

411
00:28:35,635 --> 00:28:37,886
Coffee?

412
00:28:37,921 --> 00:28:39,666
I didn't think you'd be up.

413
00:28:39,701 --> 00:28:40,699
Are you kidding?

414
00:28:40,734 --> 00:28:41,686
I've already worked out with my trainer,

415
00:28:41,716 --> 00:28:43,056
made 10 calls to New York,

416
00:28:43,086 --> 00:28:45,540
read 2 scripts and the trades.

417
00:28:45,575 --> 00:28:47,622
Have a roll from Campanile.

418
00:28:47,657 --> 00:28:49,764
Best bread on the planet.

419
00:28:49,799 --> 00:28:51,217
Fuck the carbs.

420
00:28:51,252 --> 00:28:53,677
So, how was your evening?

421
00:28:54,295 --> 00:28:56,527
Connor take good care of you?

422
00:28:56,562 --> 00:28:57,896
Yeah, he's a cool guy.

423
00:28:58,095 --> 00:28:59,096
And hot.

424
00:29:00,552 --> 00:29:03,404
Does Brian know about your extra-marital activities?

425
00:29:03,504 --> 00:29:07,119
We're not married. Brian detests marriage.

426
00:29:07,154 --> 00:29:11,246
Well, that's a unique position to take when every fag on earth wants to say "I do".

427
00:29:11,346 --> 00:29:13,659
Yeah, well, we'd rather say "I don't".

428
00:29:13,694 --> 00:29:16,767
That way we can be together because we want to be, not because we have to be.

429
00:29:16,802 --> 00:29:18,808
How very "Rage-ian".

430
00:29:20,619 --> 00:29:22,626
You better go clean up and pack.

431
00:29:22,661 --> 00:29:25,283
There'll be a car here in an hour to take you to the airport.

432
00:29:29,504 --> 00:29:33,417
By the way, I've thought about your offer.

433
00:29:33,452 --> 00:29:35,565
I really appreciate it.

434
00:29:35,600 --> 00:29:37,462
But...

435
00:29:38,449 --> 00:29:42,026
There is no "but". I want to do it.

436
00:29:42,061 --> 00:29:43,715
So I'm coming back.

437
00:29:49,445 --> 00:29:53,052
My back is killing me. That's the lumpiest ground I ever slept on.

438
00:29:53,153 --> 00:29:55,969
You weren't sleeping on the ground, you were sleeping on me.

439
00:29:56,004 --> 00:29:59,200
So I end up being your support, when you're supposed to be mine.

440
00:29:59,235 --> 00:30:01,820
Look, I woke up without any coffee, and worse, I'm out of breath mints.

441
00:30:01,855 --> 00:30:04,629
So would you kindly spare me your morning sarcasm?

442
00:30:07,133 --> 00:30:09,434
Sorry, teddy. You're right.

443
00:30:09,469 --> 00:30:13,977
I am supposed to be your support system and here I am, pulling the props out from under you.

444
00:30:14,012 --> 00:30:17,701
You go ahead, make all the sarcastic, insensitive remarks you want.

445
00:30:17,736 --> 00:30:18,969
I'm sorry too, Em.

446
00:30:19,004 --> 00:30:20,797
You've been a wonderful support.

447
00:30:21,641 --> 00:30:25,055
But if it turns out we're hopelessly lost,

448
00:30:25,090 --> 00:30:27,861
and for whatever reason I don't survive the elements,

449
00:30:27,896 --> 00:30:31,596
I want you to know you have my permission to eat me.

450
00:30:31,631 --> 00:30:36,753
Thank you, teddy. That's the most generous thing any person ever said to another.

451
00:30:40,051 --> 00:30:42,169
This is a highway.

452
00:30:42,204 --> 00:30:43,993
But which way do we go?

453
00:30:44,028 --> 00:30:46,653
Well, let's take a look.

454
00:30:46,688 --> 00:30:48,626
To hell with that!

455
00:30:48,726 --> 00:30:50,846
It hasn't led us in the right direction yet.

456
00:30:50,881 --> 00:30:52,437
Wh... sh, sh!

457
00:30:53,141 --> 00:30:54,270
What?

458
00:30:55,814 --> 00:30:57,761
Don't you hear it?

459
00:30:57,796 --> 00:30:58,775
What are you doing?

460
00:30:58,975 --> 00:31:03,134
Native Americans used to do this to hear which way the cavalry was advancing.

461
00:31:04,420 --> 00:31:06,407
Wouldn't it be easier to just look?

462
00:31:11,061 --> 00:31:12,845
Oh, my god.

463
00:31:12,880 --> 00:31:15,842
Oh, my god, it's the Liberty Ride.

464
00:31:15,877 --> 00:31:17,115
- Hi, guys! - But how?

465
00:31:17,603 --> 00:31:20,860
I guess even though we didn't know it,

466
00:31:20,895 --> 00:31:23,473
you and I have been on the right road all along.

467
00:31:23,508 --> 00:31:24,568
Come on.

468
00:31:25,858 --> 00:31:28,106
- Hey! - Hi, guys.

469
00:32:01,033 --> 00:32:04,130
Congratulations, guys. We are so proud of you.

470
00:32:04,165 --> 00:32:06,422
Here's juice, it'll perk you right up.

471
00:32:06,457 --> 00:32:09,141
Here you go, honey. Good for you.

472
00:32:12,025 --> 00:32:13,368
There you go.

473
00:32:14,998 --> 00:32:16,703
Hey.

474
00:32:17,903 --> 00:32:20,853
- Huh, we did it, teddy. - We did it.

475
00:32:25,236 --> 00:32:27,136
Welcome home, guys.

476
00:32:27,915 --> 00:32:29,652
Welcome home.

477
00:32:29,687 --> 00:32:30,992
How'd you get here so fast?

478
00:32:31,733 --> 00:32:35,469
Faith, focus, fortitude.

479
00:32:35,504 --> 00:32:37,861
Not to mention pedaling our fucking fannies off.

480
00:32:40,049 --> 00:32:40,771
Hi!

481
00:32:40,806 --> 00:32:44,261
Well, there's a little bit of sunshine straight from Hollywood.

482
00:32:44,296 --> 00:32:45,117
Hi, honey.

483
00:32:45,152 --> 00:32:46,633
How was it out there, sweetie?

484
00:32:46,668 --> 00:32:48,059
It was amazing.

485
00:32:48,094 --> 00:32:50,009
But I'm sorry I missed the ride.

486
00:32:50,044 --> 00:32:52,056
Oh, you made the best part, the big finish.

487
00:32:52,091 --> 00:32:53,752
And you'll never guess who went along.

488
00:32:53,787 --> 00:32:57,575
Brian? Yeah, he told me he wasn't going.

489
00:32:57,610 --> 00:32:59,852
Unfortunately, he had a little injury.

490
00:32:59,887 --> 00:33:01,185
Is he all right?

491
00:33:01,220 --> 00:33:04,018
Stubborn son of a bitch insisted on finishing the ride.

492
00:33:05,417 --> 00:33:07,489
Get some juice, come on.

493
00:33:10,396 --> 00:33:11,989
Well, look who's here!

494
00:33:12,024 --> 00:33:16,202
Oh, I am so proud of my men.

495
00:33:19,004 --> 00:33:20,832
So where's Michael?

496
00:33:20,932 --> 00:33:21,865
With Brian.

497
00:33:21,900 --> 00:33:23,833
Yeah, yeah, but don't worry, they should be here any minute.

498
00:34:01,245 --> 00:34:03,462
I still can't get through to them.

499
00:34:05,232 --> 00:34:07,832
I'm starting to get worried.

500
00:34:07,867 --> 00:34:11,471
Actually, I started getting worried four hours ago.

501
00:34:14,191 --> 00:34:16,391
Maybe we should go out searching.

502
00:34:26,655 --> 00:34:28,151
Look!

503
00:34:33,975 --> 00:34:35,901
No!

504
00:34:37,175 --> 00:34:39,350
Let him finish.

505
00:34:56,422 --> 00:34:57,683
Come on.

506
00:35:01,691 --> 00:35:03,558
I can't.

507
00:35:07,761 --> 00:35:09,631
We... we're almost there.

508
00:35:09,666 --> 00:35:12,732
Fuck it. Just fuck it.

509
00:35:57,545 --> 00:35:59,273
You got it, you got it, you got it. Hunter: Come on, you can do it.

510
00:36:05,798 --> 00:36:07,838
Come on!

511
00:36:07,873 --> 00:36:09,850
You're almost there, almost there. Hunter: You can do it.

512
00:36:16,863 --> 00:36:18,558
Yes!

513
00:36:25,768 --> 00:36:27,010
Sweet.

514
00:36:27,045 --> 00:36:28,098
Way to go.

515
00:36:28,133 --> 00:36:30,532
I was so worried.

516
00:36:30,567 --> 00:36:32,342
I could kill you for doing this.

517
00:36:32,377 --> 00:36:34,102
Yeah, well, I almost saved you the trouble.

518
00:36:34,137 --> 00:36:35,573
Okay.

519
00:36:38,073 --> 00:36:40,414
We thought maybe you went to the hospital.

520
00:36:40,449 --> 00:36:42,544
There's no need. Brian's going to be okay.

521
00:36:44,205 --> 00:36:46,020
No, no, I didn't mean that.

522
00:36:46,055 --> 00:36:48,610
Lindsay called around an hour ago.

523
00:36:50,242 --> 00:36:52,367
You're a dad.

524
00:37:05,190 --> 00:37:07,275
I'm a grandma.

525
00:37:08,479 --> 00:37:12,155
Way to go, Michael. I'm a grandma. Nice.

526
00:37:16,739 --> 00:37:19,555
Oh, my god. Look at her.

527
00:37:19,590 --> 00:37:22,754
Oh-h-h. You're so tiny.

528
00:37:22,789 --> 00:37:24,957
She didn't feel that way coming out.

529
00:37:24,992 --> 00:37:27,764
The labour lasted 14 hours.

530
00:37:27,786 --> 00:37:31,912
It was like passing a bowling ball through the eye of a needle.

531
00:37:32,726 --> 00:37:34,495
T.M.I.

532
00:37:35,071 --> 00:37:37,241
Too much information.

533
00:37:37,977 --> 00:37:41,092
But you're here, you're finally here.

534
00:37:41,127 --> 00:37:42,667
Have you picked out a name?

535
00:37:42,696 --> 00:37:46,606
Contingent on the approval of all three parties,

536
00:37:46,641 --> 00:37:50,783
I was thinking Jenny Rebecca.

537
00:37:51,385 --> 00:37:52,387
Late grandmothers?

538
00:37:52,587 --> 00:37:53,965
Early Streisand.

539
00:37:54,605 --> 00:37:57,795
Well, hey, uh, let's take a picture.

540
00:38:00,743 --> 00:38:01,911
There.

541
00:38:01,946 --> 00:38:03,249
Oh, okay.

542
00:38:03,284 --> 00:38:05,272
Uh, now all three parents.

543
00:38:09,220 --> 00:38:11,227
Smile.

544
00:38:13,043 --> 00:38:14,063
Oh, perfect.

545
00:38:14,098 --> 00:38:17,374
Okay, now how about one with the two happy moms?

546
00:38:21,463 --> 00:38:23,335
Come on, get closer.

547
00:38:25,164 --> 00:38:27,416
Closer.

548
00:38:31,048 --> 00:38:32,002
Got it.

549
00:38:32,037 --> 00:38:34,591
Oh, that'll be one to frame.

550
00:38:48,028 --> 00:38:49,325
There you go.

551
00:38:49,425 --> 00:38:52,527
The "Jenny Rebecca triple ripple hot fudge sundae"

552
00:38:52,562 --> 00:38:55,157
named in honour of my gorgeous new granddaughter.

553
00:38:55,392 --> 00:38:59,320
It took Joan Crawford 20 years to get a sandwich named after her at the Stage Deli.

554
00:38:59,535 --> 00:39:01,288
Why don't you boys sit down?

555
00:39:01,388 --> 00:39:03,910
Uh, thanks but, uh, we prefer to stand.

556
00:39:03,945 --> 00:39:05,592
Bums are a little battered.

557
00:39:05,692 --> 00:39:08,205
Ah. Well, you, I understand.

558
00:39:08,240 --> 00:39:09,527
But you?

559
00:39:09,562 --> 00:39:11,869
You're a disgrace to Nelly bottoms everywhere.

560
00:39:14,747 --> 00:39:17,347
The first thing I did when I got home last night:

561
00:39:17,382 --> 00:39:18,244
Weigh myself.

562
00:39:18,279 --> 00:39:20,874
Huh, you too? So how much did you lose?

563
00:39:20,909 --> 00:39:21,954
Seven pounds.

564
00:39:22,154 --> 00:39:23,722
Five and a half.

565
00:39:23,757 --> 00:39:25,735
Couldn't have done it without you.

566
00:39:25,770 --> 00:39:27,220
Lost weight?

567
00:39:27,255 --> 00:39:28,694
The ride, Em.

568
00:39:28,729 --> 00:39:31,178
Sure you could've.

569
00:39:31,413 --> 00:39:32,871
Maybe.

570
00:39:33,168 --> 00:39:36,436
But I'd rather have done it with my best friend.

571
00:39:40,531 --> 00:39:42,185
Hey, no. Mine, quit it.

572
00:39:42,985 --> 00:39:44,427
You just quit that. Ah-ha-ah.

573
00:39:48,459 --> 00:39:49,404
Psst.

574
00:39:50,205 --> 00:39:51,463
Carl!

575
00:39:51,498 --> 00:39:52,687
Look what I got you.

576
00:39:52,717 --> 00:39:55,208
I love it.

577
00:39:55,243 --> 00:39:56,543
I thought you would.

578
00:39:56,578 --> 00:39:59,100
It's a lot more accurate than the one you're wearing.

579
00:40:01,384 --> 00:40:02,825
Thank you.

580
00:40:02,855 --> 00:40:05,116
So now that you're a grandmother,

581
00:40:05,151 --> 00:40:07,097
are you ready to be a bride?

582
00:40:07,232 --> 00:40:08,422
Carl...

583
00:40:08,457 --> 00:40:09,899
What kind of a wedding do you want?

584
00:40:09,934 --> 00:40:11,141
Big? Small?

585
00:40:11,176 --> 00:40:12,507
Indoor? Outdoor?

586
00:40:12,542 --> 00:40:14,643
Although it's still a little nippy.

587
00:40:14,678 --> 00:40:15,843
It's up to you.

588
00:40:15,878 --> 00:40:17,996
Whatever you say.

589
00:40:19,647 --> 00:40:21,345
Whatever I say?

590
00:40:23,304 --> 00:40:25,463
In that case...

591
00:40:25,498 --> 00:40:27,923
I don't want a wedding.

592
00:40:27,958 --> 00:40:30,410
No wedding?

593
00:40:30,610 --> 00:40:33,579
I can't marry you. And not because I don't love you,

594
00:40:33,614 --> 00:40:35,655
because god knows, I do.

595
00:40:35,990 --> 00:40:37,482
Then what?

596
00:40:38,522 --> 00:40:42,812
How can I get married when my own son can't?

597
00:40:42,847 --> 00:40:47,436
And the... and the goddamn president wants to change the constitution

598
00:40:47,471 --> 00:40:51,065
to prevent Michael and Ben and... and all the other beautiful gay men and women

599
00:40:51,100 --> 00:40:53,644
from having the same rights that you and I do?

600
00:40:55,145 --> 00:40:57,207
It just doesn't seem right.

601
00:40:57,407 --> 00:41:00,579
That's very noble, sweetheart, but you're just one person.

602
00:41:00,779 --> 00:41:03,658
Well, sometimes that's all it takes.

603
00:41:03,693 --> 00:41:04,737
Look at Gandhi.

604
00:41:04,772 --> 00:41:07,911
Ben Kingsley starved himself,

605
00:41:07,946 --> 00:41:09,678
but it turned the tide.

606
00:41:09,713 --> 00:41:11,945
You're not going to starve yourself, are you?

607
00:41:11,980 --> 00:41:15,214
There's only so much I'm humanly capable of.

608
00:41:15,249 --> 00:41:17,909
I am going to send a message,

609
00:41:17,944 --> 00:41:19,621
and the finger,

610
00:41:19,656 --> 00:41:21,900
to the white house.

611
00:41:22,667 --> 00:41:29,752
Until my son can walk down the aisle in this country, then neither will I.

612
00:41:36,705 --> 00:41:39,115
Where does that leave us?

613
00:41:39,250 --> 00:41:45,078
How do you feel about living together?

614
00:41:45,784 --> 00:41:47,591
In sin.

615
00:41:51,717 --> 00:41:54,125
Aren't we a little too old for that?

616
00:41:54,325 --> 00:41:56,713
Christ, I hope not.

617
00:42:02,001 --> 00:42:05,122
She's so much calmer than Gus was.

618
00:42:06,031 --> 00:42:09,071
Yes you are, you cutie.

619
00:42:09,302 --> 00:42:11,428
Remember how fidgety and fussy he was?

620
00:42:11,463 --> 00:42:14,120
I should. It was my breast.

621
00:42:14,455 --> 00:42:17,296
Well, this isn't nearly as painful as I thought.

622
00:42:17,331 --> 00:42:19,533
Get back to me in a few weeks.

623
00:42:19,568 --> 00:42:23,373
You'll be wishing she'd find someplace else to eat.

624
00:42:23,408 --> 00:42:27,611
Aw. You're finally here.

625
00:42:29,471 --> 00:42:32,420
You have no idea how much your mommy wanted you,

626
00:42:32,455 --> 00:42:35,440
and what she had to go through to get you.

627
00:42:35,639 --> 00:42:37,930
Don't worry. I'll be sure and tell her.

628
00:42:38,296 --> 00:42:40,338
That old Jewish recipe?

629
00:42:40,373 --> 00:42:44,547
Add one tablespoon of guilt to mother's milk, stir briskly.

630
00:42:48,816 --> 00:42:53,561
We have, without a doubt the most beautiful children god has ever created.

631
00:42:53,762 --> 00:42:55,068
I won't argue with that.

632
00:42:55,103 --> 00:42:56,900
That's nice for a change.

633
00:42:59,139 --> 00:43:01,900
I didn't mean it...

634
00:43:05,478 --> 00:43:07,504
Do you need anything?

635
00:43:07,539 --> 00:43:08,603
No, I'm fine.

636
00:43:08,643 --> 00:43:11,371
All right, young lady, time for your nap.

637
00:43:11,406 --> 00:43:13,530
You'll see your mommies later.

638
00:43:16,039 --> 00:43:17,014
Yeah.

639
00:43:17,049 --> 00:43:19,148
Sweet dreams, sweetheart.

640
00:43:19,183 --> 00:43:21,195
Sleep tight.

641
00:43:30,065 --> 00:43:33,184
I contacted the center's child care services.

642
00:43:33,219 --> 00:43:36,886
They have a list of several women who can come help you out.

643
00:43:36,921 --> 00:43:39,601
And Dusty said if you need anything, you can call her.

644
00:43:39,701 --> 00:43:41,228
What about you?

645
00:43:43,668 --> 00:43:46,685
Then you're really going?

646
00:43:47,128 --> 00:43:49,882
It's what we both agreed to...

647
00:43:49,917 --> 00:43:52,605
isn't it?

648
00:44:20,048 --> 00:44:23,692
On behalf of the Gay And Lesbian Center,

649
00:44:23,727 --> 00:44:32,412
I'd like to present Liberty House with this cheque for $432,000.

650
00:44:37,432 --> 00:44:43,935
Every cent raised will go to maintaining the hospice and providing its clients with the best care possible.

651
00:44:43,970 --> 00:44:46,642
We'd like to thank everyone who rode,

652
00:44:46,677 --> 00:44:48,355
who lent their support,

653
00:44:48,390 --> 00:44:50,713
their time, their sponsorship.

654
00:44:55,311 --> 00:44:59,579
And now, in honour of one of our brothers who we recently lost.

655
00:44:59,614 --> 00:45:02,756
A great friend, a volunteer and supporter.

656
00:45:02,791 --> 00:45:05,894
Liberty House has been renamed

657
00:45:05,929 --> 00:45:09,238
"Vic Grassi House".

658
00:45:16,841 --> 00:45:20,010
Thank you very much for coming.

659
00:45:22,869 --> 00:45:24,780
Yeah.

660
00:45:24,815 --> 00:45:26,853
Huh, god.

661
00:45:28,713 --> 00:45:30,120
Did you know about this?

662
00:45:47,558 --> 00:45:49,899
You got them to do this, didn't you?

663
00:45:52,855 --> 00:45:55,078
It's still America, Deb.

664
00:45:55,113 --> 00:45:56,092
Money talks.

665
00:45:56,292 --> 00:45:58,779
Yeah, but for once it said the right thing.

666
00:46:09,039 --> 00:46:11,876
Your uncle would be so proud.

667
00:46:11,911 --> 00:46:15,147
Too bad he couldn't be here to see it.

668
00:46:15,182 --> 00:46:17,483
He sees it.

669
00:46:18,839 --> 00:46:20,816
Come on.

670
00:47:16,092 --> 00:47:18,113
So...

671
00:47:18,148 --> 00:47:20,578
have I atoned for my sins?

672
00:47:20,613 --> 00:47:23,026
That would take an eternity.

673
00:47:23,061 --> 00:47:25,494
But you sure as hell get an "A" for effort.

674
00:47:25,529 --> 00:47:27,134
Please don't say hell.

675
00:47:27,542 --> 00:47:30,842
By the way, I happen to agree with you.

676
00:47:31,804 --> 00:47:34,885
I was damn lucky to get those four extra years.

677
00:47:34,920 --> 00:47:37,235
Sure I'd have liked more.

678
00:47:37,270 --> 00:47:38,821
Who wouldn't?

679
00:47:38,856 --> 00:47:41,837
But you're going to have a lot more than that.

680
00:47:41,872 --> 00:47:44,229
Did god tell you that?

681
00:47:44,264 --> 00:47:46,998
Actually, he told Judy and she told me.

682
00:47:47,033 --> 00:47:48,703
Judy?

683
00:47:48,738 --> 00:47:50,523
Garland.

684
00:47:50,758 --> 00:47:52,586
They're like this.

685
00:47:52,621 --> 00:47:54,870
You mean god's a...?

686
00:47:55,070 --> 00:47:58,819
You didn't hear it from me.

687
00:48:01,544 --> 00:48:03,103
Ow!

688
00:48:04,460 --> 00:48:05,834
Ow.

689
00:48:05,869 --> 00:48:07,099
You okay?

690
00:48:11,093 --> 00:48:13,477
It'll be all right.

691
00:48:13,512 --> 00:48:16,545
I heard it on the best authority.

692
00:48:22,340 --> 00:48:24,229
So, did you fuck Tom Cruise?

693
00:48:24,264 --> 00:48:27,251
Everybody knows he's not gay.

694
00:48:29,094 --> 00:48:30,791
Adrien Brody?

695
00:48:30,826 --> 00:48:33,359
Nice, but, alas...

696
00:48:33,394 --> 00:48:35,362
Tobey Maguire?

697
00:48:35,397 --> 00:48:36,729
Please.

698
00:48:36,764 --> 00:48:38,132
What?

699
00:48:38,755 --> 00:48:40,847
Connor James.

700
00:48:42,358 --> 00:48:44,276
No shit.

701
00:48:47,953 --> 00:48:51,561
Sounds like you had a most excellent adventure.

702
00:48:52,691 --> 00:48:55,175
Sounds like you did too.

703
00:48:55,893 --> 00:49:00,053
Bicycling down life's endless highways...

704
00:49:00,763 --> 00:49:02,233
I had time to think.

705
00:49:02,874 --> 00:49:04,418
Oh?

706
00:49:05,671 --> 00:49:10,741
About what I'd do differently if I survived cancer...

707
00:49:12,078 --> 00:49:14,601
and sleeping in a tent.

708
00:49:14,636 --> 00:49:17,363
Equally unpleasant, I agree.

709
00:49:18,284 --> 00:49:20,902
But now that you have, what did you decide?

710
00:49:22,999 --> 00:49:25,940
The first thing I'd do differently...

711
00:49:27,012 --> 00:49:29,311
is the bedroom.

712
00:49:30,938 --> 00:49:34,196
And get rid of that thing over the bed.

713
00:49:34,231 --> 00:49:36,862
Yeah, it's very '90s. I agree.

714
00:49:40,252 --> 00:49:44,996
And then I'd like to spend more time with my son.

715
00:49:45,860 --> 00:49:50,676
He's at an age now where he needs a strong, masculine influence.

716
00:49:51,999 --> 00:49:56,080
Especially being raised by a couple of dykes.

717
00:49:57,390 --> 00:50:00,637
I mean, he's got to know about Armani...

718
00:50:01,232 --> 00:50:04,053
Gucci, Prada,

719
00:50:04,088 --> 00:50:07,698
not just football and engine-tuning.

720
00:50:07,936 --> 00:50:10,046
Unquestionably.

721
00:50:10,081 --> 00:50:11,735
Any other decisions?

722
00:50:16,240 --> 00:50:18,281
I want you to move back in.

723
00:50:20,297 --> 00:50:21,703
Huh?

724
00:50:22,013 --> 00:50:25,799
I said I'd like it if you and I were to live together.

725
00:50:27,662 --> 00:50:29,321
Are you proposing?

726
00:50:29,421 --> 00:50:30,691
Of course not.

727
00:50:30,726 --> 00:50:33,579
With the sudden and unexpected plethora of gay marriages,

728
00:50:33,614 --> 00:50:36,334
I'd hate to add to the glut.

729
00:50:37,445 --> 00:50:40,876
All this running back and forth between here and Daphne's is time consuming,

730
00:50:40,911 --> 00:50:43,754
and inconvenient. I mean, just last week

731
00:50:43,789 --> 00:50:46,823
you forgot your socks and had to borrow a pair of mine.

732
00:50:48,131 --> 00:50:50,072
And...

733
00:50:51,197 --> 00:50:54,567
as for the times when you're not around,

734
00:50:54,767 --> 00:50:58,168
I wouldn't particularly mind it if you were.

735
00:50:59,930 --> 00:51:03,943
I've been waiting for you to ask me that since the first night you brought me here.

736
00:51:07,696 --> 00:51:09,867
Well, then what do you say?

737
00:51:11,631 --> 00:51:17,129
Should I make room in my drawers for your drawers?

738
00:51:38,725 --> 00:51:40,189
Ben?

739
00:51:46,263 --> 00:51:48,012
Ben?

740
00:51:49,292 --> 00:51:51,739
Mmm... hm?

741
00:51:53,363 --> 00:51:56,298
I was just seeing if you were asleep.

742
00:51:57,795 --> 00:51:59,846
I'm wide awake.

743
00:51:59,881 --> 00:52:01,844
Now.

744
00:52:02,952 --> 00:52:04,528
Are you okay?

745
00:52:04,563 --> 00:52:06,443
I don't know.

746
00:52:06,477 --> 00:52:10,866
I just can't seem to settle down, you know? Too much excitement, I guess.

747
00:52:10,901 --> 00:52:14,751
Ah-h-h. Has been pretty eventful.

748
00:52:14,786 --> 00:52:18,854
No shit. My head is spinning.

749
00:52:18,889 --> 00:52:23,797
The ride and the baby and the wedding.

750
00:52:23,832 --> 00:52:26,537
Can you believe we're really married?

751
00:52:27,377 --> 00:52:29,127
Are we?

752
00:52:31,415 --> 00:52:32,784
Really?

753
00:52:36,413 --> 00:52:38,232
Of course we are.

754
00:52:39,285 --> 00:52:43,044
But we don't live in Canada. We live here.

755
00:52:43,079 --> 00:52:47,227
So, is it still real?

756
00:52:48,100 --> 00:52:49,972
Let me ask you a question.

757
00:52:50,007 --> 00:52:54,007
Even if it was real for just a day,

758
00:52:54,008 --> 00:52:56,136
was it worth it?

759
00:53:03,317 --> 00:53:05,342
So worth it.

760
00:53:05,377 --> 00:53:08,317
It won't be long before it happens here.

761
00:53:08,352 --> 00:53:10,590
It's all beginning.

762
00:53:10,625 --> 00:53:13,035
And we're part of it.

763
00:53:22,390 --> 00:53:25,701
You know, come to think of it,

764
00:53:25,736 --> 00:53:29,305
we never really had a proper wedding night.

765
00:53:30,321 --> 00:53:32,842
Sure we did.

766
00:53:33,414 --> 00:53:36,701
Shivering in our tent.

767
00:53:36,736 --> 00:53:40,029
Hm. On our little air mattresses.

768
00:53:41,636 --> 00:53:43,987
I think we can do better than that.
See ya next spring. ;)



## S05E01

1
00:00:00,000 --> 00:00:04,162
WWW.MY-SUBS.CO

1
00:00:00,500 --> 00:00:02,000
<font color="#ffff00" size=14>www.tvsubtitles.net</font>

2
00:01:54,116 --> 00:01:56,003
In a world of shadow.

3
00:01:56,004 --> 00:01:58,334
Where the undead stalk the night.

4
00:01:58,696 --> 00:02:04,179
Rage and Zephyr struggle to escape the land of the clones.

5
00:02:20,820 --> 00:02:22,260
Do you know what amazes me?

6
00:02:22,260 --> 00:02:23,160
What, dear?

7
00:02:23,160 --> 00:02:27,320
Outside a child is born, a man dies, a couple gets marries...

8
00:02:27,320 --> 00:02:29,570
The ever changing kaleidoscope of life.

9
00:02:30,950 --> 00:02:33,750
In here... nothing changes.

10
00:02:34,440 --> 00:02:39,170
Everything's the same. Same hot guys, same thumpa-thumpa...

11
00:02:39,170 --> 00:02:40,970
same shaved chest...

12
00:02:42,290 --> 00:02:46,050
And what a comfort it is to know.

13
00:02:46,600 --> 00:02:49,570
But it's all a lie, an illusion, just...

14
00:02:50,020 --> 00:02:52,250
...cheap theatrics.

15
00:02:52,250 --> 00:02:56,420
Nevertheless... let's keep dancing.

16
00:03:05,760 --> 00:03:08,560
I promised Ben I'd be home by midnight.

17
00:03:08,560 --> 00:03:10,560
Aah, pathetic!

18
00:03:11,850 --> 00:03:14,310
Well be sure and thank your husband for me for

19
00:03:14,310 --> 00:03:17,610
allowing you to come out and play with your poor lonely friend.

20
00:03:17,610 --> 00:03:19,960
I noticed you left out "old".

21
00:03:19,960 --> 00:03:23,610
Well you'd be a lot less lonely when you're reunited with your beloved.

22
00:03:23,610 --> 00:03:25,350
Hey, you'd better not say anything!

23
00:03:25,350 --> 00:03:27,320
When have I ever...

24
00:03:28,740 --> 00:03:30,330
Fine. Nevermind.

25
00:03:32,040 --> 00:03:33,380
I give you my word.

26
00:03:33,380 --> 00:03:36,190
Swear to it. On the memory of Marylin Monroe.

27
00:03:36,190 --> 00:03:39,870
I swear on the memory of Marylin Monroe that I will not tell Justin

28
00:03:39,870 --> 00:03:43,610
that you're flying to L.A this weekend to surprise him, and that you love him,

29
00:03:43,610 --> 00:03:45,800
and you miss him more than words can express.

30
00:03:46,380 --> 00:03:47,790
Who said anything about that?

31
00:03:47,790 --> 00:03:51,200
Look, you don't fool me, Mr. I am a rock, I am an island.

32
00:03:51,200 --> 00:03:53,150
I know how hard it's been for you.

33
00:03:54,370 --> 00:03:56,180
You have no idea, Mikey.

34
00:03:56,180 --> 00:03:57,340
How odd.

35
00:04:09,130 --> 00:04:11,120
Hey, Todd!

36

How's it going?

37
00:04:12,950 --> 00:04:14,360
Fine...

38
00:04:16,850 --> 00:04:19,690
Hey dickhead! Turn off your fucking cell phone!

39
00:04:21,300 --> 00:04:22,510
What's up?

40
00:04:23,030 --> 00:04:27,700
Just lying here, eating a bag of Dorritos, reading the Brothers Karamazov.

41
00:04:28,700 --> 00:04:30,230
What about you?

42
00:04:30,230 --> 00:04:32,400
Anna Karinina, and Pringles.

43
00:04:33,420 --> 00:04:37,970
I always said it was our love of Russian literature and snacks high in saturated fat

44
00:04:37,970 --> 00:04:39,970
that brought us together.

45
00:04:40,990 --> 00:04:42,120
So how's work?

46
00:04:42,120 --> 00:04:44,420
Up to my ass in storyboards.

47
00:04:44,420 --> 00:04:49,020
But Brett is thrilled. He says he never could have envisioned the project without me.

48
00:04:49,020 --> 00:04:51,020
He's even talking about a sequel.

49
00:04:51,790 --> 00:04:53,390
My superhero.

50
00:04:53,890 --> 00:04:57,160
The only trouble is, pre-production is slower than we expected.

51
00:04:57,160 --> 00:04:59,160
So I might have to stay longer than I thought.

52
00:05:01,640 --> 00:05:03,200
How much longer?

53

Another three months, maybe four.

54
00:05:08,010 --> 00:05:11,730

55
00:05:14,300 --> 00:05:16,150
You're not pissed, are you?

56

Why the fuck would I be pissed?

57

I told you before you went out there, the only reason I'd be pissed is if you didn't go.

58
00:05:23,190 --> 00:05:25,460
So when are you coming out here?

59
00:05:25,460 --> 00:05:27,460
You'd fucking love it.

60

You never know when I just might drop in.

61

Well, you'd better hurry...

62
00:05:34,000 --> 00:05:38,020

63

I miss you.

64
00:05:45,580 --> 00:05:48,120
Hey you take care of yourself, you hear?

65
00:05:48,650 --> 00:05:52,750
Do the best work you can, and have the best time you can.

66
00:05:52,750 --> 00:05:54,750
It's all that matters.

67

She has your big button eyes...

69

Well, she's got one thing of Mel's that I don't have.

71

Oh, she's so young, it's hard to tell who she looks like.

72
00:06:33,310 --> 00:06:36,460
At this point, she's just a sleep, eat and poop machine.

73

Oh yeah, but she is our little sleep, eat and poop machine.

74
00:06:41,740 --> 00:06:43,880
Sweet dreams, honeybun.

Honeybun?

77

79

She's not pestering you, is she? If she is, just tell me. I hate when she pesters.

80

Are you sure you guys don't need any groceries? Got diapers, what about talcum powder...

Of course they do, after all these years they're like a fine tuned machine.

83
00:07:10,220 --> 00:07:11,950
I can't wait to be an old married couple.

84

Don't rush it, it's nice to be newlyweds too.

85

How many years has it been? - Two hundred.

Ten. This week, actually.

87

89
00:07:24,610 --> 00:07:26,440
Too tired, too busy.

90

91

When your tits start lactating, call me.

Bye! Bye...!

96

00:07:58,770 --> 00:08:00,770

99

and they will.

100

Eventually.

101
00:08:27,050 --> 00:08:29,790
I just wanna grab some pantyhose and my lasagna pan.

102

103

don't they have enough pans at my house?

104
00:08:35,160 --> 00:08:37,810

105

106
00:08:40,700 --> 00:08:41,430
Wait...

You just brought over all those owls with all those...

108

Carl...

What?

112
00:08:58,910 --> 00:09:01,180
Shit. I don't know how to say this...

113

You? Not know how to say something?

114

It's about your place.

115

116

Nothing! No, nothing's the matter with your place.

It's just...

118

It's not this place.

119

120

121

Too many sad memories.

122
00:09:29,500 --> 00:09:33,120
It's true, and at the time all that I could think about was losing Vic.

123
00:09:34,110 --> 00:09:36,210
But since I've been gone...

124
00:09:36,210 --> 00:09:40,890

125
00:09:45,410 --> 00:09:48,760
I've lived in this house almost thirty years.

126
00:09:48,760 --> 00:09:51,130
That's practically all of Michael's life...

127
00:09:53,030 --> 00:09:57,120
There were days where we could barely muster up the mortgage, and...

128

129

This house is a part of me.

130

And I've never been away from it until now.

131
00:10:14,270 --> 00:10:19,360
There's nothing, nothing wrong with your place, sweetheart, I love being there with you.

132

133

Honey...

134

136

Wherever you are is home to me.

137

138

Thank you!

139
00:10:47,420 --> 00:10:48,670
Thank you.

140

Oh yeah!

Fuck me like you mean it, come on!

Welcome home.

What are they giving me a look for? This isn't a fucking back room!

148
00:11:36,310 --> 00:11:37,230
Michael!

149
00:11:38,230 --> 00:11:40,050
I'm just curious.

150
00:11:39,950 --> 00:11:42,420
Packed to the rafters, one of them looks just like...

Hey dudes, you're home.

Why aren't you?

153
00:11:46,260 --> 00:11:50,680
Jason and Troy asked me if we had the new Christina Aguilera CD. So I loaned them ours.

154
00:11:51,130 --> 00:11:53,610
That'll be the last we see of that, thank you very much!

155
00:11:53,610 --> 00:11:56,510
You don't belong over there with guys who've been partying all night!

156
00:11:56,510 --> 00:11:58,750
I was just trying to be neighbourly...

157
00:11:58,750 --> 00:12:00,280
And maybe cop a little weed.

158
00:12:00,280 --> 00:12:03,390
You should be studying for your midterm! - Crack those books, pal.

159

Give me the ice cream, I'll put it in the freezer.

160

They seem kind of cranky to you?

Who?

162
00:12:15,930 --> 00:12:16,950
Mel and Linds.

No more than usual.

164
00:12:18,950 --> 00:12:22,340

165

166

167

168

169

I seriously doubt that would ever happen.

170
00:12:50,300 --> 00:12:51,390
Hey!

171
00:12:51,390 --> 00:12:54,320
I thought when you got married you'd fuck less.

172
00:13:16,280 --> 00:13:18,560
Counting down the hours, Bri?

173

I'd be too, you lucky bastard.

174

Zooming off to Los Angeles for a little sunshine...

Well, before you fly away,

176

177

178

183

Not too shabby?! For being in business a year, it's over the fucking moon!

It all yours.

191

192
00:14:16,550 --> 00:14:18,550
So what do you suggest?

193
00:14:20,810 --> 00:14:23,020
The best investment there is...

194
00:14:23,020 --> 00:14:24,080
Yourself!

195
00:14:24,080 --> 00:14:28,730
Spend it on you! You've worked like a sonofabitch, you went through hell and back with your...

196

But, thank god, you're okay, so...

197

treat yourself to something special! Go buy a new toy!

I've got dildoes up the ass.

00:14:41,030 --> 00:14:42,550
Like...

Like his own personal Lear jet so he can wing back and forth from the coast to visit you.

00:14:57,630 --> 00:15:00,940

He's so cute!

I'm Devon's biological father.

Same mom however, it's important to us that they'd be related.

210
00:15:16,600 --> 00:15:20,760
Finally got the kids down, I had to sing "Under the Sea" six times.

Jenny Rebecca, um, but we call her J.R.

Jimboree down the block.

Between here and where Ilay and Monty live.

Sure...

249
00:17:05,110 --> 00:17:08,090

250

Charming spacious apartment to share, own bedroom, private bath, no pets...

252

bottoms only need apply.

Perfect.

00:17:32,080 --> 00:17:34,130

00:17:35,860 --> 00:17:39,870
Remember the look on the old farmer's face just before it devoured him?

261
00:17:41,740 --> 00:17:46,100
So I've decided to save everyone the discomfort of going through another embarrassing scene,

262
00:17:46,100 --> 00:17:48,410
kindly fold my tent, and...

Teddy? How many of those power bars have you had?

265

Look, I know you don't wanna hear this,

00:18:09,760 --> 00:18:13,960
so please, please promise me you won't take it the wrong way...

271
00:18:13,960 --> 00:18:18,290
but as your friend I feel it's my obligation to tell you. You're getting a little...

A little what?

273
00:18:20,770 --> 00:18:23,140
A little... hardy.

274
00:18:23,750 --> 00:18:26,530
I mean... robust.

275
00:18:26,530 --> 00:18:28,530
I mean... - Fat.

276
00:18:29,110 --> 00:18:31,760
Fat? I've become fat?

277
00:18:31,760 --> 00:18:35,430
Well let's put it this way. If you start singing, it's all over.

278
00:18:36,480 --> 00:18:38,230
I'll have you know, I'm not fat. I'm just...

279
00:18:38,230 --> 00:18:40,230
I'm bulking up.

280
00:18:40,230 --> 00:18:45,720
I was a shadow of my former self when I was on crystal, and I shed quite a few pounds during the Liberty Ride.

281
00:18:45,720 --> 00:18:48,300
And I happen to think I look pretty damn good.
